decision_conditions: With regard to Section 96A of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, the totality of the proposed amendments are considered to constitute a material change to the original application, particularly having regard to the location of the site in a Conservation Area and its relationship with Grade II Listed Buildings. As such, the proposals do not fall within the scope of a 'non-material' amendment to the original planning permission.
description: Non material amendment to 25/00325/HOU to allow changes to roof slate, cladding, vehicle access opening and metal gates, reduction to front extension and French heritage doors replacing picture window and entrance door (PART RETROSPECTIVE).
